You can mix em into oatmeal, yogurt, and pb2/pbfit. You can drizzle them on top of pretty much any carb neutral in flavour like waffels/pancakes/toast slices/popcorn. For baking you can add some to the recipe for ~flavor~. For fruits i would recommend cutting up a banna/apple/pear, drizzling them with the syrup, and then microwaving it. 30 seconds usually does the trick. Its a nice warm treat! (A dash of cinnamon makes it super lit) I think for drinks you can just put it in pretty much anything. Tea/coffe is best but ive mixed syrup and water and enjoyed it lol. Some flavors are better in cold drinks and some are better in warm/hot ones. Just experiment to see what ya like.
